faqSection.title: SaaS Products & Cloud setups
faqSection.subtitle: Common answers regarding email migration timelines, pricing plans, CRM automation, and data protection policies.

items.question: Will we experience downtime during Google Workspace or M365 migration?
items.answer: No. We implement a dual-delivery routing process during migrations. This ensures all your active email accounts remain operational, and zero messages are missed while files and archives transfer in the background.

items.question: Can you host Tally Prime on Cloud for remote multi-user access?
items.answer: Yes. We host Tally on a highly secure cloud virtual server. This permits your accounting and audit staff to access real-time financial records from anywhere via remote login protocols, with automatic backups.

items.question: How do you help optimize our monthly SaaS licensing costs?
items.answer: Our specialists audit your user list to identify inactive, suspended, or overlapping accounts. We also align your requirements with the most cost-effective Microsoft, Google, or Zoho subscription tiers, eliminating waste.

items.question: What is the difference between Google Workspace and Microsoft 365?
items.answer: Google Workspace is highly optimized for web-native, real-time collaboration via Google Drive, Docs, and Gmail. Microsoft 365 offers robust desktop-installable software like Word, Excel, and advanced enterprise device security controls (Intune).

items.question: What security policies do you configure during onboarding?
items.answer: We enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), configure secure DNS setups (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to prevent domain phishing, establish email spam-blocking thresholds, and structure Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing helpdesk support for password resets and employee onboarding?
items.answer: Yes. We offer monthly Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that act as an outsourced IT helpdesk. Our ticketing system handles immediate user additions, access changes, license assignments, and security audits.
